verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official CLI in its Agentic Toolbox (qodo-docs-5, qodo-docs-7, qodo-probe-4), and a community user corroborates hands-on use of the 'Qodo Command CLI' with real feature details like permission toggles (qodo-comm-3). This shows a first-party CLI aimed at agentic workflows (reviewing changes, retrieving rules) rather than just a chat UI. Missing for 10: deeper independent reviews of the CLI's full command surface and broader adoption evidence beyond a single HN comment.
